name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of Mars) — 1 Basic — Strike True

system.description:
In a flash of magical clarity the warrior's perceptions and reflexes sharpen, and every obstacle between blade and foe seems to fall away.

Invoke Strike True when making a close-combat attack (bare hands or a melee weapon), before you make the challenge. You gain one free retest on that attack alone. You may make no other attacks this turn, though you can still use multiple actions normally, such as moving or readying a weapon. Retest with Occult.
